children: RNS Number : 8758U  Schiehallion Fund Limited (The)  15 September 2026

The Schiehallion Fund Limited announces, in accordance with UKLR 6.4.9R(2,) that Graeme Proudfoot, a non-executive director of the Company, has been appointed as a non-executive director of BioPharma Credit Plc, with effect from 15  September 2026.
